Description: 

We’re seeking a Plant Manager - Asphalt who’s ready to put your skills to work on projects that matter — and build a career with a company that’s building North America.

 

**Job Title:** Plant Manager - Asphalt **| Req ID:** 18651 | **HR Contact:** Fredric Victor THOMPSON| **Location:** Stoughton MA

 

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

 

The Plant Manager is accountable for the leadership, development & management of all functions of the HMA manufacturing business at this location. The Plant Manager will ensure lean staffing and oversee safe production to enable plant productivity and maintenance in an efficient manner, while producing quality products for customers. The primary focus will be on safety, compliance and optimum manufacturingmaximizing productivity at the lowest cost of production. Responsible for coordinating, monitoring and supervising the activities of one or more asphalt plants. The Plant Manager communicates goals to department employees and ensures that goals are achieved. Maximizes employee participation to achieve the desired team approach. Develops departmental personnel to enhance skills, improve responsiveness and promote business growth.

**WHAT YOU'LL ACCOMPLISH**

* Coordinate the execution of general plant operations activities. Coordinate field management activities.
* Help coordinate activities such as transportation and receiving of product at the plant.
* Ensure that we produce quality products that meet or exceed customer expectations
* Inspect product quality ensuring all criteria meets plan. Recommend measures to improve production methods and equipment performance.
* Provides timely and accurate tickets for customers. Runs loader or dozer at bins and stock pile, and performs plant maintenance and housekeeping.
* Monitor, recommend, implements repairs and routine maintenance of equipment, buildings and grounds.
* Investigates abnormal operating events or equipment failures to determine cause; makes adjustments,repairs, and/or modifications as needed.
* Directly supervises 2 – 8 employees in the HMA division . Coach, train, mentor employees on the safe and efficient method of operating plant equipment. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.
* Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees, planning, assigning and directing work rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
* Supports and assists personnel in achieving timely and
 
 efficient production schedules. Records employees’ time in online timekeeping system.
* Communicates and promotes safety, compliance and environmental requirements in alignment with company standards within production area. Monitors work performed and addresses situations that do not conform to standards.
* Demonstrate a commitment to communicating, improving and adhering to health, safety and environmental policies in all work environments and areas. Promote a culture of safety and exhibit these behaviors.
 

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
 
**Education:** Bachelor's degree or 6 years of equivalent experience
 
**Required Work Experience:** Minimum of six years of production-related work experience. Related supervisory or group leader experience preferred.
 
**Required Technical Skills:** Basic computer skills with ability to enter information in SAP and time recording software and working with Microsoft Office applications

 

**Additional Requirements:**

* Successful candidates must adhere to all safety protocols and proper use of Amrize approved. Personal Protection Equipment ("PPE"), including but not limited to respirators. Subject to applicable law, employees that are required to wear respirators must be clean shaven where the respirator seal meets the face in order to pass the qualitative and quantitative fit tests.

card.title: Head of Validation - Manufacturing
card.description:
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
  
 Gilead Sciences is seeking an experienced validation leader to head the Manufacturing Validation function at the Foster City site. This role will establish and lead an integrated, risk-based validation program for the facilities, utilities, equipment, automation, and computerized systems supporting a new state-of-the-art biologics facility. In partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Automation, IT, and project teams, this leader will define the validation framework, build the capabilities required for execution, and ensure the new facility is compliant and inspection-ready from startup through routine operations. The successful candidate will also lead and integrate the existing validation team supporting the site’s small-molecule clinical manufacturing pilot plants and warehouse. 
   
 Required Skills: 
 Demonstrated leadership of validation for the startup and licensure of a new biotech or biologics manufacturing facility. 
 Significant experience designing and implementing risk-based, lifecycle validation approaches in a GMP-regulated environment. 
 Deep technical knowledge of facility, utility and equipment qualification and computer system validation, including applicable regulatory expectations and industry standards. 
 Proven ability to build validation organizations and governance, establish clear accountabilities, and lead employees, contractors, and partner functions through complex startup programs. 
 Strong cross-functional influence, decision-making, and communication skills, with an unwavering commitment to quality, data integrity, cGMP compliance, and patient safety. 
 
 Job Responsibilities: 

 Establish the site validation strategy 
Develop and implement an integrated, risk-based validation strategy, governance, acceptance criteria, and oversight model for facilities, utilities, process equipment, automation platforms, and GMP computer systems supporting the new Foster City biologics facility. 
 Lead validation through facility startup 
Provide site validation leadership and oversight from design and construction through commissioning, qualification, process readiness, and transition to routine GMP operations in alignment with the overall project schedule. 
 Implement risk-based validation 
Apply science- and risk-based principles to focus testing and documentation on critical aspects, leverage supplier and commissioning evidence where appropriate, and maintain clear traceability to patient, product, and data-integrity risks. 
 Build a high performing validation department
Provide leadership guidance and coaching for existing and new validation department employees, forecast and manage workload, and support employee career growth. 
 Build governance and execution capability 
Establish standards, procedures, templates, metrics, and decision forums; define roles across internal teams, engineering partners, vendors, and contractors; and develop a high-performing validation organization sized for each phase of the program. 
 Drive inspection readiness and sustainable operations 
Partner with Quality and system owners to ensure the new biologics facility and existing small molecule facilities are inspection-ready, including validation ownership, periodic review, change control, requalification, maintenance of the validated state, and continual improvement. 
  
 Qualifications: 

 Requires a Masters degree with 8+ years of relevant professional experience, or BS with 10+ years of relevant professional experience – a degree in a relevant scientific or business discipline is strongly preferred. 
 Hands-on experience implementing risk-based validation in a biopharmaceutical manufacturing environment. 
 Excellent organizational and communication (both written and verbal) skills. 
 Demonstrated experience leading and engaging a team of technical experts. 
 
 The ideal candidate would also have:
 Significant experience with facility, equipment and utility qualification for startup of a manufacturing facility. 
 Significant experience with computerized system validation in a biopharmaceutical environment. 
 Strategic thinking and ability to influence and constructively challenge the status quo. 
 
 
The salary range for this position is: $182,070.00 - $235,620.00. Gilead considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans*.

card.description:

For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.

As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
 As part of Gilead's Enterprise Data and ERP strategy, we are seeking a Senior Manager, SAP Manufacturing and Planning to serve as the Product Owner for enterprise-wide manufacturing execution, production planning, and shop floor digitization capabilities across our pharmaceutical and biologics manufacturing network.  
 
This leader will define and execute the enterprise roadmap for S/4HANA Production Planning (PP), Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)/Digital Manufacturing, Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and segmentation capabilities, while enabling GxP-compliant manufacturing transformation across Pharmaceutical Development, Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Kite organizations. 

 This position will report to the Associate Director, IT ERP PDM. This is an onsite role based on Foster City, CA or Raleigh, NC. We do offer a hybrid environment with three days in office and two days work from home. 

  
 Key Responsibilities 

 Manufacturing Strategy & Business Partnership 
 Develop and articulate a comprehensive SAP Manufacturing solution roadmap that aligns with the company's long-term business objectives within the Life Sciences sector. 
 Architect scalable and flexible SAP solutions that can adapt to evolving business requirements and regulatory landscapes. 
 Partner with Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain leaders to define enterprise production priorities. 
 Establish standards, operating procedures, and best practices for production planning and shop floor execution. 
 Evaluate and recommend emerging SAP technologies and best practices to enhance system performance and efficiency 
 Drive manufacturing data quality, GxP compliance, standardization, and business value realization. 
 Produce detailed architectural blueprints, including data flow diagrams, system interface specifications, and configuration documentation. 
 Manufacturing & Platform Ownership 
 Own the strategy, governance, architecture, and continuous improvement of S/4HANA PP, MES/Digital Manufacturing, and MRP platforms across multiple sites. 
 Govern enterprise SAP manufacturing domains, including Production Orders, Routings, BOMs, Work Centers, Batch Management, and Shop Floor Integration.  
 Define enterprise standards for production planning, execution, and manufacturing data quality within a validated (GxP) environment.  
 Lead integration strategy connecting third-party MES platforms — including Werum PAS-X — with S/4HANA PP, MRP, and (where relevant) IBP/Kinaxis for seamless demand-supply and shop floor alignment. 
 Delivery Leadership & Operational Excellence

 Summary of the position: 
 
 Reporting to the HGAP Vice President of Operations, the successful candidate collaborates with the VP and the executive leadership team to execute manufacturing plans that drive corporate strategy and profitability.
 
 This role requires a visionary leader who can align manufacturing strategies with business objectives, drive continuous improvement initiatives, and ensure the highest levels of safety, cost, quality, efficiency, utilization and on-time finish.
 
 The incumbent maintains full ownership of all fabrication, machining, and assembly operations. This mandate includes directing facility management, preventative maintenance, continuous improvement initiatives.
 
 This role directly impacts revenue growth by optimizing production costs and improving efficiency, productivity, and employee engagement.  Strong project management skills, PMP certification is a plus.

**Job Title:** Director, Enterprise Business Transformation & Operational Excellence

**Location:** Westfield, IN

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

 
 

We are seeking a hands-on transformation leader to drive enterprise-wide strategy, operating-model improvements, and value creation across a complex, multi-site industrial business. This role is a core member of the organizational leadership team, with a mandate to personally lead, structure, analyze, and execute transformation initiatives—working directly with executive leadership and cross-functional teams to turn strategy into measurable results.

 
 

This person will operate as a strategic problem solver and execution partner, identifying opportunities, building business cases, redesigning processes, and driving initiatives through implementation and value realization. For the right candidate, this role offers a clear path to building and leading a dedicated transformation team as the capability matures within the organization.

 
 

**OVERALL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Personally lead enterprise transformation and operating-model improvement initiatives from problem definition and strategy through execution and measurable value realization.
* Analyze business performance, identify operational and financial improvement opportunities, and develop actionable recommendations.
* Drive operational excellence initiatives using Lean, Six Sigma, and continuous-improvement methodologies to improve cost, quality, safety, delivery, and profitability.
* Lead and support M&A activities, including due diligence, post-merger integration, carve-outs, and synergy/value-capture initiatives.
* Build and maintain transformation roadmaps, business cases, financial models, project plans, KPIs, and governance mechanisms.
* Work directly with commercial, finance, and operations leaders to improve P&L performance, profitable growth, and value creation.
* Identify opportunities to modernize core systems and processes, including ERP/SAP, and evaluate AI-enabled and digital solutions based on measurable business impact.
* Facilitate cross-functional working sessions, resolve complex business problems, and personally drive critical initiatives to completion.
* Collaborate with colleagues in our Strategy and Transformation office in Europe, contributing to globally coordinated initiatives and sharing best practices across geographies.
* Present findings, recommendations, progress, and results to executive leadership and other key stakeholders
 

 

**KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS REQUIREMENTS**

* 10+ years of experience in transformation, strategy, operations, management consulting, or operational excellence, ideally within industrial, manufacturing, automation, or supply-chain environments.
* Demonstrated experience personally driving complex transformation initiatives from analysis through implementation, rather than primarily overseeing teams or programs.
* Proven track record of delivering measurable results, including revenue growth, margin expansion, cost reduction, productivity improvements, and other value-creation initiatives.
* Deep expertise in operational excellence, Lean / Six Sigma, and structured problem solving; Black Belt preferred.
* Experience with M&A integration, operating-model design, process optimization, and value-capture initiatives.
* Strong financial acumen, including P&L, EBIT, business cases, ROI, planning, and financial modeling.
* Strong analytical, strategic, and execution skills with the ability to move from high-level strategy into detailed implementation.
* Excellent executive communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.
* MBA from a leading program and/or an engineering background strongly preferred.
* Experience with AI-enabled / digital transformation and agentic GTM.

The Senior Manager is accountable for maintaining an audit-ready facility, driving continuous improvement, building organizational capability, and supporting the successful production of pharmaceutical drug products.

 Key Duties and Responsibilities: 
 Manage and develop a supervisory team, ensuring strong execution, accountability, and team effectiveness.

At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 

 Key Responsibilities: 
 GMP Operations Quality Oversight 
 ·        Provide Quality Assurance oversight of GMP Manufacturing and QC testing operations through the product lifecycle from master cell bank to drug product.
 ·        Provide Quality Assurance strategy and oversight of external QC laboratories, ensuring method lifecycle activities (qualification, verification, and validation) are executed in compliance with cGMP, ICH, and internal quality standards, with appropriate review and approval of protocols, reports, and methods.
 ·        Review and approve laboratory investigations (e.g., OOS/OOT/deviations) conducted by contract partners, ensuring thorough root cause analysis, robust corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), and aligned decision-making impacting product quality and disposition.
 ·        Apply Quality Risk Management principles to oversee risk assessments in collaboration with Manufacturing, and QC operations.
 ·        Partner with cross-functional teams to identify, assess, and mitigate quality risks impacting product quality, patient safety, and supply continuity.
 ·        Ensure quality risk decisions are appropriately justified, documented, and aligned with internal procedures and regulatory expectations.
 ·        Partner with Manufacturing operations and QC to resolve quality issues arising during manufacturing, laboratory activities and material receipt and shipping. Oversee implementation and manufacturing workflow development for the startup of digital manufacturing and data solutions in collaboration with manufacturing, automation, engineering, and information technology teams.
 ·        Review and approve manufacturing and test records, deviations, investigations, change controls, and CAPA to ensure product quality and support timely product disposition.
 ·        Evaluate operational and quality risks related to new product introduction.
 Compliance, Audits & Inspections 
 ·        Participate in internal GMP audits and routine walk-throughs of Manufacturing, QC, and Warehouse areas to support continuous improvement.
 ·        Serve as a key Quality contact during regulatory inspections and internal audits, including preparation and response to findings.
 ·        Monitor regulatory requirements and proactively assess potential operational compliance risks.
 Quality Systems & Documentation 
 ·        Approve GMP documentation including risk assessments, procedures, master batch records, specifications, and analytical methods. Drive continuous improvement of quality processes supporting GMP operations.
 Leadership & Collaboration 
 ·        Provide leadership, development, and mentoring for Quality personnel supporting GMP operations.
 ·        Partner cross-functionally with Manufacturing, QC, Process Development, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality management on corporate and site initiatives.
 ·        Lead or support Quality-related operational projects and improvement initiatives.
 ·        Provide on-call Quality Assurance support to Manufacturing and QC operations, as required.
 ·        Use risk-based decision making to prioritize tasks and ensure product quality.
 ·        Maintain strong working knowledge of Health Canada, FDA, and global GMP expectations.

 Knowledge: 
 ·        Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMPs) and/or Good Laboratory Practices (GLPs).
 ·        Demonstrates in-depth knowledge of QA principles, concepts, industry practices, and standards.
 ·        Demonstrates keen understanding of Computer Systems Validation and ICH Guidelines.
 ·        Demonstrates excellent verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills.
 ·        Demonstrates knowledge of Six Sigma, Define-Measure-Analyze-Improve-Control (DMAIC) methodology, performance measures and quality improvement statistical.
 ·        Demonstrates working knowledge of Risk Management tools (e.g., Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) and / or Failure Mode Effects Analysis (FMEA)).
 ·        Certification by ASQ (Certified Quality Auditor, Certified Quality Engineer, and Certified Quality Manager) or other industry-recognized professional organizations.
 
 Specific Education & Experience Requirements: 
 ·        10+ years of relevant experience in a GMP environment related field and a Bachelor’s degree in science or related field OR 
 ·        8+ years of relevant experience and a MS OR 
 ·        5+ years of relevant experience and a PharmD/ PhD
 ·        Extensive hands-on experience supporting biologics, GMP Manufacturing and QC operations is required.
 ·        Proven experience leading investigations, CAPA, and change management in a GMP operational environment is required.
 ·        Strong understanding and experience of materials management, manufacturing and analytical methods and testing systems within a GMP environment.
 ·        Previous experience in people management within Quality is required.
 ·        Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills are required.

 Preferred: 
 ·        Experience supporting Health Canada, FDA, or other regulatory inspections
 People Leader Accountabilities:  
 ·        Create Inclusion - knowing the business value of diverse teams, modeling inclusion, and embedding the value of diversity in the way they manage their teams. 
 ·        Develop Talent - understand the skills, experience, aspirations and potential of their employees and coach them on current performance and future potential. They ensure employees are receiving the feedback and insight needed to grow, develop and realize their purpose. 
 ·        Empower Teams - connect the team to the organization by aligning goals, purpose, and organizational objectives, and holding them to account. They provide the support needed to remove barriers and connect their team to the broader ecosystem.

For more than 35 years, we’ve tackled diseases such as HIV, viral hepatitis, COVID-19 and cancer – working relentlessly to develop therapies that help improve lives and to ensure access to these therapies across the globe. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientific innovations. Our employees are our greatest asset as we work to achieve our bold ambitions, and we’re looking for the next wave of passionate and ambitious people ready to make a direct impact.
 
 We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfil their aspirations. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

 Job Description 
 
 The Product Quality Lead (PQL) supports one or more assigned products/programs and serves as the serve as a product expert providing technical, scientific and strategic expertise and leadership to Product CMC (Chemistry Manufacturing and Controls) / Product Development and   Manufacturing (PDM) Team and Product Quality Team (PQT) during clinical development through commercialization, acting as the single point of contact for product quality. The PQL will define the product Quality and Compliance strategy for the assigned products by leveraging their understanding of product development to facilitate the execution of the strategies that enable the efficient commercialization of products. The PQL is responsible for end-to-end Product Quality deliverables, including ownership, authoring, and review of GMP and regulatory documentation (including Product Quality sections of filings such as JOS), and management of product quality data such as comparability assessments, Annual Product Quality Reviews (APQRs), and product quality risk assessments. The PQL is responsible for evaluating and driving overall Product Health by proactively identifying and mitigating product risks and issues, ensuring continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle. The role supports cross-functional Product Quality initiatives to strengthen compliance, enhance product quality, and enable robust lifecycle management. The PQL also serves as the primary Quality interface for alliance management and due diligence activities, ensuring alignment and effective collaboration with external partners.   
   
 Job Functions:   
 Provide quality leadership on cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, driving alignment and decision making, performing a scientifically sound and risk-based evaluation of process and product quality data, and developing patient-oriented strategies.   
 Execute/drive product strategies through strong quality and scientific knowledge related to product development, technology transfers, global regulatory filing strategies, analytical methods, stability, drug substance and drug product specifications and In-Process Controls (IPCs).   
 Lead Product Quality Team (PQT) activities to align on product quality strategy, priorities, and deliverables across the product lifecycle.   
 Through the product quality risk register, drive identification, assessment, and mitigation of product quality risks using a science- and risk-based approach.   
 Monitor and review cross-functional process and product data to identify trends and ensure quality and compliance risks are proactively addressed and escalated, as needed.   
 Lead the development of control strategies, including in-process control, starting material, drug substance and drug product specifications, stability strategy, and comparability approaches.   
 Review and approve regulatory filings and support responses to health authority questions.   
 Provide cross-functional guidance to align product quality strategy across development, manufacturing, analytical, and regulatory stakeholders.   
 Assess product quality impact for changes, deviations, and events, and ensure appropriate implementation plans are developed.   
 Support drug substance and drug product technology transfer and new product launches.   
 Ensure inspection readiness, including PAI/PLI preparation through participation as a product expert.   
 Apply science- and risk-based evaluation to complex issues and develop practical, patient-focused solutions that balance quality, regulatory expectations, and business needs.   
 Communicate complex quality and technical information clearly to leadership, cross-functional teams, and regulatory agencies.   
 Act as delegate to Commercial Product Quality Head, as needed   
   
 Knowledge, Experience and Skills:   
 In-depth understanding of cGMP principles and applicable regulatory guidelines and directives (e.g., ICH, EP, JP, USP, 21 CFR).   
 Demonstrated experience applying science- and risk-based approaches to product quality, including control strategy, comparability, and lifecycle management.   
 Solid knowledge of drug substance and drug product development, manufacturing processes, and associated quality considerations.   
 Experience working in cross-functional teams within a matrix environment, with the ability to influence decisions without direct authority.   
 Proven ability to lead or contribute to complex product/program activities, including regulatory filings, product quality assessments, and lifecycle management.   
 Experience supporting inspections (e.g., PAI/PLI) and interacting with regulatory agencies.   
 Strong technical and analytical skills, with the ability to interpret complex product and process data and translate insights into risk-based decisions.   
 Ability to identify, assess, and communicate product quality risks and drive appropriate mitigation strategies.   
 Effective problem-solving skills, including developing practical, patient-focused solutions to complex quality issues.   
 Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey complex quality and technical information to cross-functional teams, leadership, and regulatory agencies.   
 Ability to operate independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.   
 Basic Qualifications:   
 Prior Quality leadership and technical management experience in development and/or commercial programs.   
 12+ years of relevant experience and a bachelor’s degree in science or related fields; or 10+ years of relevant experience and an advanced science degree such as MS, Pharm D, PhD Demonstrated experience and knowledge in quality in a highly regulated manufacturing environment.   
 Direct experience with regulatory health authority submissions (e.g. IND, NDA, BLA, MAA) and/or inspections.   
 Broad experience across several including analytical product characterization, process validation, drug development experience, packaging/labeling and understanding of Parenteral, Oral Solid Dosage, and Biologics.   
 Preferred Qualifications / Skills:   
 5+ years working in a regulated environment (either direct GMP or technical support).   
 Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills, including facilitation and presentation skills, are essential in this collaborative work environment.   
 Communicate complex ideas succinctly and clearly, both verbally and in writing, to a variety of audiences.   
 Ability to influence others through persuasive interactions and garner support for novel solutions where applicable.   
 Must be able to work on multiple projects simultaneously and demonstrate ability to organize, prioritize and manage time.   
 Comfortable in a fast-paced company environment with minimal direction and able to adjust workload based upon changing priorities.   
 Experience with authoring or review of BLA/MAAs, INDs/IMPDs, supplements/variations or similar regulatory documentation, highly desired.   
 Experience supporting non-conformance investigations, authoring, reviewing and defending critical product impacting non-conformances.   
 Ability to work and navigate within an evolving

card.title: Sr Director, Quality Control - Analytics & Product Testing
card.description:
Advancing medicine to save lives. Together.  
  
 Thanks to many decades of experience and our passion for what we do, we make an essential contribution to the global availability of biopharmaceuticals, especially for patients with rare and serious diseases.  
  
 Rentschler Biopharma SE is a leading contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) focused exclusively on client projects. We offer customized full-service solutions for bioprocess development and the production of complex biopharmaceuticals. As a German family-owned company with an international footprint and global reach, we combine experts, expertise and years of experience to develop best-in-class solutions – together with our clients.
 Rentschler Biopharma has approximately 1,400 employees and is headquartered in Laupheim, Germany, with a site in Milford, MA, USA. In 2024, we joined the United Nations Global Compact, underlining our commitment to sustainability.  
  
 As an independent family-owned company, we live by the motto: Many hands, many minds - ONE TEAM! Open, respectful cooperation characterizes our working environment, where quality awareness, diligence and responsibility are our top priorities. With all the diversity of our talents in the Rentschler team, we pursue one vision together: advancing medicine to save lives. 
 
 
 
As a member of the Rentschler Biopharma Quality Control leadership team in Milford, the Sr Director Quality Control - Analytics & Product Testing will primarily be responsible for leading a Quality Control team responsible for analytical method qualification/validation, testing incoming samples (including process intermediates, drug substance and/or drug product), and providing timely results that support GxP manufacturing and product disposition. The QC Analytics & Product Testing team is composed of analytical leaders, scientists and QC analysts that cover 7-day per week testing. This role will collaborate with Quality Control Technical Services and Quality Operations Support & Stability staff to periodically evaluate processes to ensure that QC activities are efficient, timely in terms of delivery of client contract deliverables, and safeguard data integrity. The successful candidate will need to be flexible and agile with the ability to pivot quickly to changing circumstances and business needs.  
  
 Duties and Responsibilities 

 Lead QC Analytics & Product Testing team and laboratory activities
 Hire and develop employees within the department, while setting clear expectations for success
 Provide active feedback, coaching and employee development
 Act as Portfolio manager for QC project work including scheduling, prioritizing and resource planning to ensure client contract deliverables are met
 Oversee analytical method transfer and method validation activities – requiring in-depth understanding of protein chemistry and analytical chemistry methodologies (incl. peptide mapping, glycan analysis, SEC-HPLC, IEX-HPLC, potency analysis by chromogenic assay)
 Participate in Milford Site Quality Leadership team meetings and follow up action plans
 Collaborate within QC to support authoring, review and/or approval of QC related documents ensuring all appropriate documents are generated and retrievable per GMP standards in support of regulatory submissions and inspections
 Support the team in managing OOS/OOT investigations, deviations and change controls, and implementing appropriate CAPA as it relates to QC
 Provides representation in customer and authority audits and implementation of resulting corrective measures
 Responsible for supporting operational aspects of the QC Analytics laboratory, including data verification, PO management, records management, etc.
 Drives continuous improvement initiatives to enhance productivity and efficiency within QC
 Collect and report quality control metrics via Quality Management Reviews and the Quality Council
 Consistently advise site and Quality management of potential and actual actions that could adversely affect the business; represent quality exposures or represent opportunities to be pursued
 Promotes a strong Quality Culture based on the Rentschler core values
  
 Qualifications 

 A bachelor's or master's degree in chemistry, biochemistry or a related life science field with substantial hands-on experience in Quality Control related activities
 18+ years of industry experience in a GMP QC environment, with a minimum of 8+ years of managerial and project management experience
 Leadership skills to manage technical and laboratory personnel 
 Strong sense of accountability, self-motivation, and drive in meeting project objectives
 Direct experience in managing and overseeing QC related activities internally and at third party vendors
 Understanding of FDA/EU/ICH regulations and guidance related to critical quality attributes, release testing, analytical validation and transfer, and stability testing
 Proven ability to lead and implement multiple projects/tasks simultaneously with competing and/or changing priorities ensuring effective time management
 Excellent facilitation and project management skills, with strong verbal and written communication skills
 Ability to effectively communicate across all levels and cross-functional teams
 Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in a team environment
 
 Working Conditions 

 Normal office working conditions: computer, phone, files, fax, copier
 Personal Protective Equipment must be worn as required
 Minimum travel required
 Will interact with other people
 Pace may be fast and job completion demands may be high 
 
 Working Conditions 


 PPE as required

 $210,000 - $260,000 

 Disclosure Statement 

 Rentschler Biopharma, Inc is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The base pay range listed for this position is the anticipated annual base salary range the organization reasonably, and in good faith, expects to pay for this position at this time. Actual compensation is determined based on several factors that may include seniority, education, training, relevant experience, relevant certifications, geography of work location, job responsibilities, or other application factors permissible by law. The annual base salary is just one component of our Total Rewards package, which also includes our annual discretionary bonus program, medical insurance, our generous 401K program, plus a host of other benefits to aligned to support our employees’ personal and professional wellness. The salary pay range is subject to change and may be modified at any time.

card.title: Director, Commercial Quality-Packaging and Labeling
card.description:
Job Description 
 GENERAL SUMMARY: 
 The Quality Operations Director provides operational leadership for commercial resupply and lifecycle management of primary and secondary packaging and labeling across a global CMO network. The role translates strategy, capacity plans, and business priorities into an efficient operating model across global CMO portfolios.  
 The Director leads a risk-based quality oversight structure required to assure compliant, reliable, and uninterrupted commercial supply. The role leads a high-performing organization and serves as a senior Quality partner to CMO leadership, Vertex Sr Director of quality operations, Manufacturing &technical operations, Supply Chain, Regulatory, Launch/Technical Quality, and other internal and external stakeholders.
  
 KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 The responsibilities of this position will include, but are not limited to, the following:
 Lead operational quality oversight for commercial resupply and lifecycle management of finished goods primary and secondary packaging and labeling activities across US and UK/EU CMOs.
 Translate departmental strategy and business priorities into operational quality plans, resource priorities, and execution expectations for the packaging and labeling quality team
 Proactively build team capability, an inclusive environment and drive consistent team execution. Provide direct leadership for people managers and/or senior staff, demonstrating understanding of team strengths and development areas and leveraging expertise effectively through performance management, talent development, coaching, and succession planning.
 Lead prioritization, decision-making, and coordination across packaging and labeling operational quality activities so that issues are managed at the appropriate level and business results are delivered across the organization
 Act as the primary escalation leader for significant packaging and labeling operational quality issues, ensuring timely triage, risk assessment, communication, and appropriate resolution
 Lead cross-functional operational forums related to commercial resupply and lifecycle packaging and labeling quality, ensuring clear accountability, decision tracking, follow-through, and alignment across internal stakeholders and CMO partners
 Ensure robust procedural oversight of exemption management, QP-related activities, artwork and packaging process change controls, and batch documentation review within the scope of the function
 Ensure robust procedural oversight for disposition of commercial primary and secondary packaged goods, CMO oversight and QTA compliance monitoring,  including risk-based assessment of changes, investigations, jurisdictional limitations and quality events that may affect release or supply status
 Ensure quality processes for commercial resupply and lifecycle packaging and labeling operations are maintained and continuously improved to support compliance, efficiency, business continuity, and risk mitigation across all commercial SM and bio/combo device modalities and product lines.
 Monitor, and trend operational quality metrics and KPIs; ensure metrics identify emerging risks, support management review; ensure team is prepared to collate executive slide presentations for each level of quality governance and leadership review (APQR, Ops Review, QMR, GPLB etc.)
 Build and maintain effective working relationships with CMO Leadership, Qualified Persons, and other external partner leadership to support compliant and reliable commercial operations partnership
 Ensure robust resupply quality input to operational deviation/investigation RCA, CAPA, efficacy checks, product impact assessments, and process support for product complaint investigations related to pack and label operations.
 Ensure inspection and audit readiness within the function and provide leadership support for inspections, responses, and follow-up actions as needed
 Partner with senior Vertex QA leadership on organization design, operating model effectiveness, and capability-building needs across the packaging and labeling quality organization
 Drive clarity of roles, responsibilities, and decision rights across the team to enable appropriate ownership at all levels within the resupply unit as well as across partner interfaces
  
 KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS: 
 Strong leadership capability with demonstrated success leading through managers and senior professionals in a complex GMP environment

 Vertex is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation to create transformative medicines for people with serious diseases. As Vertex continues to grow, we are accelerating capabilities in technology and data to remain at the forefront of science, medicine, and technology.

 Demonstrated success developing and implementing technology strategies within complex organizations, preferably pharmaceutical Quality organizations.
 Proven experience delivering multiple complex technology development or transformation initiatives.
 Extensive knowledge of global Quality environments and the ability to translate user needs into effective technology solutions.
 Strong understanding of biotech regulatory requirements, compliance, and integrity in systems, processes, and actions.
 Demonstrated ability to communicate strategic ideas, technology solutions, and complex concepts to technical and non-technical audiences at all organizational levels.
 Exceptional strategic thinking, problem-solving, organizational leadership, and team-building capabilities.

 Artificial intelligence and machine learning
 Generative AI and agentic AI
 Data-driven automation
 Data products and data science
 Quality technology platforms and transactional systems
 Quality assurance and Quality oversight technology
 Inspection readiness and inspection management
 Deviation management
 Corrective and preventive action processes
 Product batch release processes
 Internal and external technology integrations
 Software and technology solution evaluation
 Data platforms and infrastructure
 Cybersecurity and technology security considerations
 Distributed computing environments
 Cloud computing environments
 High-performance computing
 Technology architecture, standards, governance, and risk management

 Experience leading AI, data, or technology transformation in a global pharmaceutical Quality organization.
 Experience supporting clinical and commercial supply operations.
 Experience working across CMC, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and R&D functions.
 Experience partnering with external technology suppliers and service providers in highly regulated environments.
 Advanced certification in product management, Agile, software engineering, leadership, or a related discipline.
 Experience developing scalable solutions that balance innovation, operational needs, regulatory compliance, and security.
 
 Education and Experience:
